title: YEEZY BOOST 350
description: Following the ‘Turtle Dove’ and ‘Pirate’ colorways, the Yeezy Boost 350 ‘Moonrock’ features a moonrock/agate grey Primeknit upper and a moonrock Boost outsole. First previewed on Instagram by Kim Kardashian and released on November 14th, 2015, the Yeezy Boost 350 ‘Moon Rock’ was sold exclusively at stores that carried Yeezy Season One apparel.

title: YEEZY BOOST 700
description: The Yeezy Boost 700 ‘Salt’ follows a design trail originally blazed by the Yeezy 500 in November 2018. Like its predecessor, the lifestyle silhouette features a monochromatic light grey finish on a mesh base with tonal overlays in suede and leather. A sculpted midsole in matching grey, concealing full-length Boost cushioning within, features a subtle black accent, matched by the rubber outsole underfoot.

title: YEEZY BOOST 350 V2
description: The Yeezy Boost 350 V2 'Desert Sage' is outfitted in a pale green Primeknit upper with tonal rope laces and reflective detailing on the sneaker’s signature side stripe. Contrast pops of color emerge on the orange collar lining and sockliner, the latter printed with dual adidas and Yeezy branding. The minimalist build sits atop full-length Boost midsole, encased in tonal green rubber with grippy gum rubber on the outsole.

title: YEEZY BOOST 350 V2 CMPCT
description: The adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 CMPCT ‘Slate Blue’ introduces a new iteration of the popular 350 V2 silhouette. Contrasting grey and navy hues are executed throughout the patterned Primeknit upper, secured with a revised no-tie lacing system and equipped with an elastic sock-like cuff. Yeezy branding is limited to the custom sockliner. Responsive cushioning comes courtesy of a full-length Boost midsole, wrapped in a semi-translucent gum rubber cage for improved durability and support.

title: YEEZY SLIDE
description: The 2022 reissue of the adidas Yeezy Slide ‘Glow Green’ brings back an especially energetic colorway of Kanye West’s comfort sandal. Forgoing the Yeezy brand’s typical earth-tone palette, the slip-on features a fluorescent green finish throughout the one-piece EVA foam build. Exterior branding is limited to adidas’ three-stripe logo debossed on the footbed. Underfoot, the outsole utilizes a series of deep horizontal grooves, providing a combination of shock absorption and grippy traction.

title: YEEZY FOAM RUNNER INFANTS
description: The adidas Yeezy Foam Runner Infants ‘Sand’ pairs an understated monochrome palette with a futuristic silhouette composed of injected EVA foam. The sculpted upper is riddled with multiple ventilation ports throughout the vamp and side panel for improved breathability. Stamped on the interior collar, the shoe size is flanked by ‘FOAM RNNR’ and ‘Made in USA’ branding. The contoured outsole features a wavy traction pattern and a discreet adidas logo under the heel.
